subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: Which of the following speeds is equivalent to $108$ kilometers per hour? ($1$ kilometer $= 1,000$ meters)
explanation: Choice A is correct. Since $1$ kilometer is equal to $1{,}000$ meters, $108$ kilometers is equal to $108 \times 1{,}000 = 108{,}000$ meters. Since $1$ hour is equal to $60$ minutes and $1$ minute is equal to $60$ seconds, $1$ hour is equal to $60 \times 60 = 3{,}600$ seconds. Therefore, $\frac{108 \text{ kilometers}}{1 \text{ hour}}$ is equivalent to $\frac{108{,}000 \text{ meters}}{3{,}600 \text{ seconds}}$, which simplifies to $30$ meters per second.
